summary: Edible Garden AG Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that Nasdaq granted it an extension to August 15, 2026, to regain compliance with the $1 minimum bid price rule, following a July 9, 2026 hearing. If compliance is not demonstrated by the deadline, the Panel may delist the securities immediately, with jurisdiction retained through November 23, 2026. The company expects to demonstrate compliance but offers no assurance. A Mandatory Panel Monitor will apply for one year post-compliance. Watch for bid-price movements and continued listing compliance.
